name: Stars in Their Eyes
source: Rena has always been a "Jill of all trades;" dabbling in one thing and getting bored, then moving on to the next. Though she's majoring in business, it's only because she has no idea what else to do with her life. But on a day like any other, while on campus she spots a piano, and, remembering the days when she used to enjoy playing, decides to try it…
translation: 丽奈一直是个“样样通”——涉猎一件事然后厌倦，再转向下一个。虽然她主修商科，但那只是因为她不知道这辈子还能做什么。但在一个普通的日子里，她在校园里发现了一架钢琴，想起了曾经享受弹琴的日子，决定试试……
